messages:
nina: FYI acme-inc hit 401s after the API key swap in eu-west ~09:12 UTC. They reported 'invalid api key' for all requests. I can see the new key in our k8s secret, but downstream pods are still failing. link: https://acme.example/err-logs
ops-bot: rotation-job: completed rewrap for apikey:apm-prod-eu at 2026-03-16T09:06:05Z (job id: rj-8821)
ryan: Can you paste a failing curl and the pod logs? Also which mechanism reads the key in the pod (env var vs file mount vs vault-agent)
nina: failing curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -v` -> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
nina: pod log snippet (from web-frontend-57fcd): `AuthError: invalid api key` then `token verify: kid mismatch`
carla: pod uses a file mount from k8s secret at /var/run/secrets/redwood/apikey, read at entrypoint and exported as env var. We have a vault-agent sidecar, but in this cluster we mount the k8s secret for perf.
marc: quick theory: newline/whitespace got injected during secret sync or encoding difference (CRLF vs LF) which changes the actual key used for signing. Also KMS rewrap changes ciphertext metadata; if some pods read an older cached file they might keep the old key. Try comparing hashes of the value in the secret vs the value in the running container.
ryan: Can you run these in a failing pod: `kubectl exec -c web -it pod/web-frontend-57fcd -- sh -c "xxd -p /var/run/secrets/redwood/apikey | tr -d '\n'"` and compare to `kubectl get secret redwood-apikey -o jsonpath='{.data.apikey}' | base64 -d | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'`
nina: ran both: secret base64->hex: `6d7a9a...f3a0` container file hex: `6d7a9a...0d0a` (ends with 0d0a)
marc: there we go — container has CRLF (0d0a) appended. Our entrypoint used `cat /var/run/secrets/redwood/apikey > $API_KEY_FILE` but some CI wrote the secret with Windows line endings earlier. Use `tr -d '\r\n'` on read.
vault-bot: vault-sync: detected secret update for redwood/apikey at 2026-03-16T09:05:58Z, wrote new version v12 (content checksums differ)
ryan: Workaround: for now restart pods so they re-read secret (they will still get CRLF unless we strip). Patch recommendation: modify entrypoint to `export API_KEY=$(cat /var/run/secrets/redwood/apikey | tr -d '\r\n')` and push a 1-line image patch to trim newline before export.
nina: rolled the patch to staging; pushed patch to prod canary 09:40 UTC, restarted one replica. Canary returned 200 on same request.
marc: we'll add a validation hook in the operator to reject secrets with trailing whitespace and add an automatic trim flag. Created PR #7832 for the operator change.
nina: customer confirmed triangle: they restarted all pods and are green. Will follow up with ops to run a sweep to find any other secrets with CRLF in eu clusters.
ryan: also opened a follow-up playbook entry: when rotation + rewrap happens, check mounted-file hex and compare to k8s secret hex before hitting prod. Saved as runbook/rotation-verification.md
nina: thanks all :thumbsup: closing this thread once sweep completes.
